final: WITH per_color AS (SELECT p.product_color, COUNT(*) AS n FROM Invoice_Line_Items AS ili JOIN Products AS p ON p.product_id = ili.product_id GROUP BY p.product_color), overall AS (SELECT SUM(n) AS total_n FROM per_color), per_color_share AS (SELECT product_color, n, 1.0 * n / total_n AS share FROM per_color CROSS JOIN overall), avg_share AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS mean_share FROM per_color_share), kept AS (SELECT product_color, n, share, n - mean_share AS excess FROM per_color_share CROSS JOIN avg_share WHERE n > mean_share) SELECT AVG(n), AVG(share), AVG(excess) FROM kept
